## Changes completed

1. Added selected piece constants to `locales.py`:
   - `PIECE_WHITE_SELECTED = "🍌"` (yellow man selected)
   - `PIECE_WHITE_KING_SELECTED = "🍍"` (yellow king selected)
   - `PIECE_RED_SELECTED = "🐳"` (blue man selected)
   - `PIECE_RED_KING_SELECTED = "💎"` (blue king selected)

2. Added `_get_selected_piece_emoji` method to the `BoardRenderer` class in `handlers.py` that returns the appropriate selected piece emoji based on piece type.

3. Updated the selected piece display logic in `handlers.py` (line 154) to use `BoardRenderer._get_selected_piece_emoji(piece)` instead of `f"✅{BoardRenderer._get_piece_emoji(piece)}"`.

Selected pieces now display:
- 🍌 for yellow man (replaces ✅🟡)
- 🍍 for yellow king (replaces ✅💛)
- 🐳 for blue man (replaces ✅🔵)
- 💎 for blue king (replaces ✅💙)

The lint warnings are pre-existing import resolution issues and are not related to these changes. Implementation is complete.
